description: This file defines the main React component for the Subtitle Sync Platform web dashboard, handling UI rendering, user interaction, upload management, and polling for job status updates.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders the subtitle sync application's user interface and manages state and interactions.

methods.name: handleVideoChange
methods.description: Handles user input for selecting a video file and updates component state accordingly.

methods.name: handleSubtitleChange
methods.description: Handles user input for selecting a subtitle file and updates component state.

methods.name: handleJobStatusPoll
methods.description: Asynchronously polls the backend service for the current job status, updating the component state with progress or errors.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Manages the form submission process, including uploading files and initiating job status polling.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets the component state to allow for a new file upload process.
